facts.fact: NIRA's eAqoonsi app, on Google Play and the Apple app store, lets citizens carry their national ID on a smartphone as a digital credential with the same legal validity as the physical card; it has passed 50,000 downloads.
The eAqoonsi digital ID app, launched in 2025 by NIRA, is in use with more than 50,000 downloads.

More than one million digital IDs were issued as of November 2025, about 5% of the 19.7 million population (share computed from the population held), against a target of 15 million by 2029; the count is of IDs issued, not stated as people.

SOM.note: Names NIRA as leading the effort and World Bank funding, but states no operation or maintenance arrangement.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: NIRA's World Bank-funded biometric national ID project, under way since 2023, had issued more than one million digital IDs as of November 2025.
